artwork.settings.onlineHint: Downloads missing covers from thumbnails.libretro.com (libretro-thumbnails project). For this, the file list of each system is fetched once from GitHub (api.github.com) and cached for 30 days. Nintendo Switch covers come from GameTDB: its game list (about 2 MB) is fetched from gametdb.com once a month. Only game and system names or product codes are sent, no personal data. A missing Switch cover can be added on gametdb.com. Off by default.
